hint: A slice [start..end] needs 0 <= start <= end <= length; the end is exclusive, so arr[0..length] is the whole array and arr[i..i] is empty. A negative bound counts from the end (arr[-2..] is the last two elements).
message: The slice [1..4] of 'int[3]' is out of range: the end is outside 0..3.
title: Slice out of range!
